assessment.nobel_worthiness: Information design has supplied a durable framework for strategic communication with substantial influence across economic theory and applications.
assessment.attribution: Bergemann, Kamenica and Morris provide a coherent core for the formal foundations and development of the field.
assessment.maturity: The contribution is well established and has generated a large subsequent literature across theory, industrial organization and policy.
uncertainties: The appropriate boundary between foundational persuasion work and later applied contributions remains contestable.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Alternating-offer bargaining and bargaining-in-markets models fundamentally changed the analysis of strategic negotiation and decentralized trade.
assessment.attribution: Rubinstein is indispensable for the alternating-offers foundation, while Wolinsky is central to bargaining and market frictions.
assessment.maturity: These are long-standing canonical contributions with extensive theoretical and applied use.
uncertainties: The listed discovery spans distinct strands, making the optimal division of credit less clear.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The economics of networks has provided influential tools for understanding link formation, strategic interaction and diffusion.
assessment.attribution: Jackson, Kranton and Goyal are leading and complementary contributors to the core theoretical literature.
assessment.maturity: The field is mature, widely used, and connected to consequential questions in markets and society.
uncertainties: Network economics has many foundational contributors, so a three-person attribution may omit important work.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Experimental markets and behavioral game theory made controlled evidence central to the study of institutions and strategic behavior.
assessment.attribution: Plott, Camerer and Holt represent major complementary contributions to market experiments, behavioral games and experimental methodology.
assessment.maturity: The body of evidence and its methodological legacy are extensive and long tested.
uncertainties: The broad program includes several further highly deserving contributors.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The analysis and measurement of reciprocity, fairness and inequity aversion reshaped economic accounts of behavior and institutions.
assessment.attribution: Fehr and Schmidt provide central theoretical and empirical landmarks, with Falk a major contributor to the experimental program.
assessment.maturity: The ideas have been replicated, extended and integrated into labor, organizational and market-design research.
uncertainties: It remains difficult to separate this program cleanly from wider behavioral and experimental economics.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Partial identification made credible inference possible when point-identifying assumptions are not defensible, a major advance in econometric reasoning.
assessment.attribution: Manski is the clear foundational figure; Tamer and Molinari made major contributions to moment inequalities and implementation.
assessment.maturity: The approach is established across econometrics and empirical applications.
uncertainties: Its importance is methodological and diffuse, which can make its practical impact harder to delimit.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Firm heterogeneity and selection transformed modern quantitative trade and clarified the distributional and aggregate consequences of trade.
assessment.attribution: Melitz is central to the firm-heterogeneity framework, with Helpman and Redding providing major connected theoretical developments.
assessment.maturity: The framework is deeply embedded in contemporary trade research and empirical work.
uncertainties: The contribution overlaps with broader trade-policy and quantitative-trade literatures.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Structural methods for demand, competition and industry dynamics greatly expanded economists' ability to analyze market power and counterfactual policy.
assessment.attribution: Pakes, Berry and Bresnahan form a persuasive core among the listed architects of the structural industrial-organization program.
assessment.maturity: The methods have been tested and broadly adopted in industrial organization, antitrust and regulation.
uncertainties: The candidate groups numerous distinct methodological advances and several additional plausible recipients.
